title: Common Vietnamese Dishes in Pregnancy: What to Keep, Tweak, or Skip
excerpt: A nutritionist's analysis of phở, bún, cơm tấm, trứng ốp la, and street snacks — safer prep, smart pairings, and what to leave out
content:
## Introduction to Pregnancy Nutrition
During pregnancy, a well-planned diet is crucial for ensuring the health and well-being of both mother and baby. According to the World Health Organization (WHO), nutrition during pregnancy is essential for preventing health problems in both mothers and babies. In Vietnam, traditional dishes like phở, bún, cơm tấm, trứng ốp la, and street snacks are popular choices. However, not all of these dishes are safe for pregnant women to consume.

## Analysis of Common Vietnamese Dishes
### Phở
Phở is a traditional Vietnamese dish made from rice noodles, broth, and various meats. According to the CDC, the broth needs to be cooked thoroughly to ensure food safety. Pregnant women can enjoy phở if it is cooked thoroughly and does not contain unsafe ingredients like raw meat or raw eggs.

### Bún
Bún is another popular Vietnamese dish made from rice noodles and various meats or seafood. According to the NHS, seafood needs to be cooked thoroughly to ensure food safety. Pregnant women can enjoy bún if it is cooked thoroughly and does not contain unsafe ingredients.

### Cơm tấm
Cơm tấm is a popular Vietnamese dish made from broken rice and various meats or eggs. According to the EPA/FDA, eggs need to be cooked thoroughly to ensure food safety. Pregnant women can enjoy cơm tấm if it is cooked thoroughly and does not contain unsafe ingredients.

### Trứng ốp la
Trứng ốp la is a simple yet nutritious dish made from eggs. According to the NIH ODS, eggs are a rich source of folate, an essential nutrient for pregnant women. However, eggs need to be cooked thoroughly to ensure food safety.

### Street Snacks
Street snacks like bánh mì, bánh ngọt, and other snacks may not be safe for pregnant women to consume if they are not prepared and stored properly. According to ACOG, pregnant women should avoid unsafe foods like raw or undercooked foods.

## Safe Preparation and Smart Pairings
To ensure food safety and nutrition for pregnant women, it is essential to pay attention to food preparation and pairing. Here are some tips:
* Cook all ingredients thoroughly before eating
* Avoid raw or undercooked foods
* Pair dishes together to ensure adequate nutrition
* Drink plenty of water and limit sugary drinks

## Dishes to Limit or Avoid
Some dishes are not safe for pregnant women to consume, including:
* Raw or undercooked foods
* Seafood high in mercury
* Raw or undercooked eggs
* Street snacks that are not prepared and stored properly

## Conclusion
Pregnancy nutrition plays a critical role in ensuring the health and well-being of both mother and baby. Pregnant women should pay attention to food preparation and pairing, avoid unsafe foods, and ensure adequate nutrition. For more information on pregnancy nutrition, you can visit our [meal planner page](/blog/topics) or check out our [pregnancy nutrition category](/blog/dinh-duong-ba-bau).

If you have any questions or concerns about pregnancy nutrition, consult with your doctor or a registered dietitian for personalized advice.
